review_description: They installed a 1.5KW system with a 3KW Inverter so we can add panels if we wish.  Panel price at the time was $1100.

Have had solar Hot Water service installed by this company for several years now and always found their service very good. Solar power system was not the cheapest quote received, but, in view of previous experience with this local company, decided to go with them anyway. There is a 3-4 month delay in installation, so expect to have my system installed next March.

We first made contact with the supplier in April 2010 when we agreed t have the system installed but it was not until the 21st October that the system was connected to the grid, an extra ordinary length of time
Great follow up and constant updates leading to installation
It is not installed as yet, but it was agood price and they are a local company
